# Button Design Guidelines

On the tech layer, the Login with Seatalk button can be customised by yourself. To do so, change the CSS style in the code. This article provides some design guidelines for the button. To follow the guidelines, simply replace the attribute value in the code.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Here are some basic design guidelines you should follow to create the Login with SeaTalk button:

* The button should be prominently visible
* The SeaTalk logo should always be present on the button
* The button text should always read “Login in with SeaTalk”, with ‘S’ capitalized.
* Use the same size as other sign-in options for your website

# Button Sizing

![](data:image/png;base64,)

A maximum size button sould be:

* 296px (width) x 56px (height)
* 18px font Roboto medium
* Logo 26px x 26px

A default size button sould be:

* 256px (width) x 48px (height)
* 16px font Roboto medium
* Logo 22px x 22px

A minimum size button sould be:

* 224px (width) x 44px (height)
* 14px font Roboto medium
* Logo 18px x 18px

# Button Spacing

![](data:image/png;base64,)

For a center-aligned logo:

* Margin in-between 12px

For a border-aligned logo:

* Margin left 16px

Note:

* “Login with SeaTalk” text will always be centre align.

# Button Corners

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Use a border-radius of:

* Minimum 4px
* Maximum will be the height of the button

# Button Colour

![](data:image/png;base64,)

For a default (light) theme:

* Background colour: #FFFFFF
* Font colour: #000000
* Border colour: #DDDDDD

For a dark theme:

* Background colour: #454E61
* Font colour: #FFFFFF
* Border colour: None
